literature.abstract: We studied the effect of intravenous (IV)-golimumab on fatigue and the association of fatigue improvement with clinical response post hoc in adults with active ankylosing spondylitis (AS) in the GO-ALIVE trial.

literature.title: Safety of tumor necrosis factor-alpha inhibitors for treatment of ankylosing spondylitis: A meta-analysis.
literature.abstract: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a chronic immune-mediated disease affecting the sacroiliac joints and the spine, manifesting with new bone formation and osteopenia. Five tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) inhibitors (infliximab, etanercept, adalimumab, certolizumab, and golimumab) are available for the treatment of AS, however, the results for the safety of TNF-α inhibitors in the treatment of AS are not consistent.

literature.title: Obesity and rates of clinical remission and low MRI inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis.
literature.abstract: Obesity has been proposed as a risk factor for refractory rheumatoid arthritis (RA). We evaluated the impact of obesity on achieving clinical and imaging definitions of low disease activity.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 「椎體病變」若屬炎症性（如軸性脊椎關節炎、非放射學性軸性 SpA），TNF-α 在附著點炎症及椎體骨侵蝕中扮演關鍵角色；Golimumab 抑制 TNF-α 可阻斷椎體結構破壞。然而「vertebral disease」為廣義術語，若涵蓋退化性/代謝性/感染性椎體病變，則機轉連結不成立。NCT02437162（Phase 3）已終止需進一步釐清原因。

predicted_indications.disease_name: congenital hypotrichosis with juvenile macular dystrophy

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 先天性少毛症合併幼年型黃斑部退化症（HJMD）係 LPAR6 基因突變導致之遺傳性退化疾病，屬毛髮與視網膜光感受器退化機制，與 TNF-α 炎症路徑無已知關聯。TxGNN 高分可能為知識圖譜中眼部疾病節點的非特異性相似性所致。無任何支持性臨床或文獻數據。
聲帶息肉主要由機械性損傷（用聲過度）或慢性刺激導致之局部黏膜組織增生，其形成與 TNF-α 系統性炎症無直接藥理關聯。無任何臨床試驗或文獻支持，建議排除此適應症。
中耳息肉通常繼發於慢性化膿性中耳炎（感染/機械性因素），雖涉及局部炎症，但非 TNF-α 全身性免疫驅動的適應症類型。Anti-TNF 治療感染性病灶可能增加感染擴散風險。無任何臨床試驗或文獻支持。

predicted_indications.disease_name: mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to complete IL12B deficiency

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: ⚠️ 安全性警示：IL12B 完全缺乏症患者原已存在 Th1 免疫防禦缺損，無法有效對抗胞內菌（尤其分枝桿菌）。TNF-α 在肉芽腫形成及結核菌控制中不可或缺；施予 Golimumab 抑制 TNF-α 將進一步破壞本已脆弱的抗分枝桿菌免疫屏障，極可能導致播散性非典型分枝桿菌感染或結核病惡化——此為 Anti-TNF 藥物最嚴重已知安全性風險，在此族群中風險尤為極高。TxGNN 此預測結果應被判定為假陽性，不建議任何臨床探索。
